_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With 0% of 74 recent 12h windows moving ±2+ points and no directional breaker live on either side, HOLD is the statistically honest default — the coil compresses until a liquidity trigger releases it.
next_move.brains_agree: Yes — both brains call HOLD with a sideways regime; the analyst is more cautious (0.62) while the narrative writer is more convicted (0.72), but the forward call is identical.
next_move.confirmed_if: Score holds 44-48 with stablecoin_growth turning positive and fed_liquidity lifting above 15; or if moving up, btc_momentum_30d clearing 60 with funding dropping below 40.
next_move.invalidated_if: Score breaks below 38 (Denial) with VIX spiking above 80 and exchange_netflow rising above 50; or breaks above 54 (Complacency) without fed_liquidity participation.
